Title: Osney Bridge diversion Oxford
Description: Towpath closure north of Osney Bridge requiring diversion via Abbey Road and Botley Road. Ongoing repair work to Thames Water infrastructure.

Title: Marsh Lock footbridge Henley
Description: Footbridge closed on safety grounds. Diversion 2.7 miles via Shiplake taking 1h 15 minutes. Expected duration extended multiple times, currently awaiting repair design.

Title: Sandford Footbridge closure
Description: Unsafe footbridge closed north of Sandford Lock. Diverted via NCN 5 cycle path alongside railway. Path rejoined past Sandford Lock.

Title: Abingdon Weir walkway
Description: Closure during high water flows due to corrosion and safety concerns. Reopened 30 Sept 2025 with trigger-point closure system when river levels rise.

Title: Temple Footbridge near Marlow
Description: Closed May 2023 due to structural degradation. Central span removed November 2025. Side spans deemed non-viable for repair. Diversion via Bisham and Marlow roads via boat ferry.

Title: Bridge 142 Runnymede Egham
Description: Cast iron bridge closed February 2024 after tree strike and structural inspection. Diversion via A308 pavement from Runnymede Hotel to Staines. Expected closure until 2027.

Title: Bell Weir Lock diversion Runnymede
Description: Small diversion at Runnymede Pleasure Grounds around refurbishment compound. Thames Towpath remains passable with diversion around machinery.

Title: Streatley-Goring towpath diversion
Description: Half mile diversion due to eroding towpath before Goring & Streatley Bridge. Funding insufficient for full repair. Riverside route unlikely to reopen until late 2026.

Title: Penton Hook Island closure
Description: Island closed to public access since February 2025 due to ash dieback diseased trees. Thames Path main route unaffected. No through-path across island.

Title: Ten Foot Bridge Faringdon
Description: Wooden bridge closed March 2024 following structural inspection revealing safety concerns. Bridge does not carry Thames Path directly but provides alternative crossing.

Title: Brentford Grand Union Canal disruption
Description: Left bank path blocked between bridge over River Brent and Brentford Marina due to development work. No official diversion. Alternative: Brentford High Street or partial route via The Ham.
